result.reason: The operative language improves the renewal term and reduces the non-renewal deadline to 30 days, satisfying that aspect of the preferred position. However, it omits the required 60-day Vendor renewal reminder and any cap on renewal price increases. Because it includes neither the preferred CPI/3% cap nor the fallback 5% cap, it does not fully reach either playbook position. The margin comment does not cure these omissions.
